title: Primary RMS voltage
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the RMS voltage of the primary coil from the given sinusoidal expression.

title: Transformer ratio application
description: Essential: Student correctly applies the turns ratio to find the RMS voltage across the secondary coil.

title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential: Student provides the correct final answer of 100 V for the secondary coil voltage.

title: Voltmeter measurement understanding
description: Important: Student demonstrates understanding that an AC voltmeter measures RMS voltage, not instantaneous or peak voltage.

title: Peak voltage identification
description: Important: Student correctly identifies the peak voltage from the sinusoidal expression.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (V) in all steps and the final answer.

title: Confusing peak with RMS
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses the peak voltage (400√2 V) directly with the transformer ratio, forgetting the RMS conversion.

title: Ratio reversal error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly applies the turns ratio (e.g., uses 1:4 instead of 4:1) when calculating the secondary voltage.
